title: TEMPORAL DECOUPLING
acceptance_questions: Does the harness reproduce the accepted 16-frame/1 ms baseline exactly?
Does A/A replay remain exact under every variant?
Does A/B relay or wider-connectome discrimination remain present under each variant?
How sensitive are propagation counts and onset timing to clock-scale changes at fixed frame count?
How sensitive are propagation counts and onset timing to duration-and-energy-matched temporal resampling?
claim_boundary: SQ-01 is a deterministic sensitivity analysis of the frozen MoscaQuant computational model. It tests dependence on temporal discretization and runtime leak-step assumptions. It does not establish biological timing, biological robustness, market profitability, or live-trading utility.
